Ton deck apparaît dans Decks › Idées de: Your deck shows up in Decks › Deck ideas, type “Community”, under your nickname. Anyone can compare it to their collection and save it. It's a copy: “Update” sends the current list.
Ouvre ton deck dans <b>Mes decks</b> et: Open your deck in My decks and tap Publish: a Commander deck of exactly 100 cards, commander included, under your nickname (verified account, 10 decks at most). It shows up for everyone in Decks › Deck ideas, type Community, within a few minutes. Update sends your current list, Remove takes it down (so does deleting the deck). An offensive deck? Report this deck, in its sheet: it disappears from your app, and from the community after several reports.
